en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an elegant covered shopping gallery with marble columns, decorative capitals, and a glass roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the corridor, with shop windows on both sides. An arched opening at the end frames a courtyard façade with arched doorways and hanging lanterns. At the bottom of the postcard, the caption reads "Trento - Galleria Garbari."
